input.plan:
# Test Folder To Tools Migration Plan

## Confirmed Scope
- Move only `AXEL/axel_project/test/*` into `AXEL/axel_project/tools/*`.
- Keep current relative structure (no re-architecture): `qa`, `bots`, `visual_style`, and root script(s) keep their internal layouts.
- Update runtime scripts and active docs/rubrics; keep historical changelog history intact.

## Canon Alignment Check
- No conflict with combat/style invariants in `AI_DOCS.md`.
- Requires canonical-reference refresh in active governance/QA docs because multiple defaults currently point to `res://test/...`.

## File Targets
- Source tree: [AXEL/axel_project/test](AXEL/axel_project/test)
- Destination tree: [AXEL/axel_project/tools](AXEL/axel_project/tools)
- Runtime/tooling updates:
  - [AXEL/axel_project/tools/qa/run_default_playtest.ps1](AXEL/axel_project/tools/qa/run_default_playtest.ps1)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/tools/visual_style/run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1](AXEL/axel_project/tools/visual_style/run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/combat_test_scaffold_check.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/combat_test_scaffold_check.gd)
- Moved scripts with internal `res://test/...` references to rewrite after move:
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/scene_smoke_check.gd](AXEL/axel_project/test/scene_smoke_check.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/qa/canon_consistency_audit.gd](AXEL/axel_project/test/qa/canon_consistency_audit.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/playthrough_arc1_exterior.gd](AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/playthrough_arc1_exterior.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/playthrough_dialogue_loop.gd](AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/playthrough_dialogue_loop.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/variant_matrix.gd](AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/variant_matrix.gd)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_1_crt_tv.gdshader](AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_1_crt_tv.gdshader)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_2_vhs_glitch.gdshader](AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_2_vhs_glitch.gdshader)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_3_terminal_crt.gdshader](AXEL/axel_project/test/visual_style/shaders/option_3_terminal_crt.gdshader)
- Active docs to refresh:
  - [README.md](README.md)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_CANON_CONSISTENCY_AUDIT.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_CANON_CONSISTENCY_AUDIT.md)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md)
  - [AXEL/axel_project/combat/VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md](AXEL/axel_project/combat/VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md)
  - plus moved READMEs under the source tree once relocated.

## Ordered Execution Steps
1. **Preflight safety checks**
   - Verify no exact filename collisions under target merge points (`tools/qa`, `tools/visual_style`).
   - Snapshot all `res://test/` usages so post-move replacement can be verified with zero leftovers.
2. **Move tree preserving structure**
   - Relocate all children from `AXEL/axel_project/test/` into `AXEL/axel_project/tools/`.
   - Keep `visual_style` contents together so shaders/scripts land beside existing style sweep runner/output.
3. **Repair runtime/tooling references first (breakage blockers)**
   - Update PS1 launchers and combat preload references to `res://tools/...`.
   - Update moved scripts/shaders with internal preloads/includes to `res://tools/...`.
4. **Path optimization pass (small, safe)**
   - In visual-style matrix script, replace repeated full shader literals with a single root constant (same behavior, easier maintenance).
   - In QA docs, point repeated command usage toward canonical runner script where practical to reduce duplicated hardcoded paths.
5. **Active docs refresh**
   - Update active guidance and runbook docs from `test` paths to `tools` paths.
   - Keep historical changelog history intact except new migration entry.
6. **Validation and zero-leftover checks**
   - Repo-wide search for lingering `res://test/` in runtime/tooling and active docs.
   - Execute key headless commands via updated scripts (scene smoke, canon audit, bot playthrough, visual style sweep entry) to confirm no path resolution errors.
   - Confirm scaffold checks still pass through the existing QA flow.
7. **Governance logging**
   - Append one migration entry to [AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md) with source-hierarchy note if any conflict-resolution decisions were needed.

## Validation Criteria
- No runtime/path errors when running updated QA/style commands.
- No unresolved `preload`, `#include`, or script-entry paths pointing to `res://test/...` in active execution paths.
- Active docs/rubrics reference new `tools` locations; historical records preserved as agreed.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  scanCurrentRefs[ScanCurrentRefs] --> moveTree[MoveTestTreeToTools]
  moveTree --> fixRuntime[FixRuntimeAndToolPaths]
  fixRuntime --> optimizePaths[ApplyPathOptimization]
  optimizePaths --> refreshDocs[RefreshActiveDocs]
  refreshDocs --> validate[ValidateNoBrokenRefs]
  validate --> changelog[AppendAiChangelogEntry]
```

content.text:
Migration is complete. All six plan todos are done.

## What changed

**Moved** everything from `AXEL/axel_project/test/` into `AXEL/axel_project/tools/` with the same structure:
- `scene_smoke_check.gd` → `tools/scene_smoke_check.gd`
- `bots/` → `tools/bots/`
- `qa/*.gd` → merged into `tools/qa/` (alongside existing Python/PS1)
- `visual_style/` → merged into `tools/visual_style/` (scripts + `shaders/` beside existing `run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1` and `output/`)

**Updated paths** from `res://test/...` → `res://tools/...` in:
- QA launchers (`run_default_playtest.ps1`, `run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1`)
- All moved GDScript preloads and shader `#include`s
- Combat preload sites (`combat_test.gd`, `combat_test_scaffold_check.gd`)

**Optimized** `variant_matrix.gd` with a `SHADER_ROOT` constant instead of three full shader path literals.

**Refreshed active docs**: `README.md`, `AI_DOCS.md`, QA rubric/audit/run log, verification checklist, structure doc, and moved READMEs (`README_gd_scripts.md` in `qa/` and `visual_style/` to distinguish from Python tooling).

**Removed** the empty `test/` folder and OneDrive-resurrected duplicate copies that caused `class_name` collisions.

**Logged** the migration in `AI_CHANGELOG.md` (historical changelog entries left unchanged).

## Validation results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `res://tools/scene_smoke_check.gd` | OK (6 scenes) |
| `res://combat/test/combat_test_scaffold_check.gd` | OK |
| `res://tools/qa/canon_consistency_audit.gd` | OK (`CANON_AUDIT_JSON` emitted) |
| Bot playthrough scripts | Both exit 0 |
| Active code `res://test/` references | None remaining |

Visual style sweep **loads** at the new path; baseline PNG capture failed in headless mode (display/write issue, not a path error). Use the PS1 runner with a visible Godot session for screenshots.

## Note for your machine

If Godot ever reports duplicate `class_name` errors after OneDrive sync, delete any resurrected `AXEL/axel_project/test/` folder and reopen the project so the class cache rescans. I also updated `.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg` locally for the five moved `class_name` scripts.

---

**Cause:** Scripts lived under `test/` while tooling already used `tools/`, and OneDrive left duplicate files at the old path after the move, causing Godot `class_name` collisions.

**Fix:** Git-moved the tree into `tools/`, updated every="`res://tools/...`" references, deleted duplicate `test/` files, and refreshed the Godot class cache.

**What to learn:** In Godot, `res://` paths and `class_name` registrations must stay in sync when you move folders — update preloads, launchers, docs, **and** remove old copies so Godot does not load the same class twice.
